summary: Keurig Dr Pepper filed a routine Form 8-K under Items 8.01 and 9.01 announcing that its Board of Directors declared a regular quarterly cash dividend of $0.23 per share. The dividend is payable in U.S. dollars on October 9, 2026, to shareholders of record as of September 28, 2026. No advisor, premium, stake, or transaction terms are stated. This is an ordinary capital-return declaration rather than a special situation; the only items to watch are the ex-dividend and record dates and any future change to the payout policy.
